note: Embedded as inline DrawingML chart (c:chart) or extended chart (cx:chart) depending on chartType. Data via inline spec or per-series props. Mirrors pptx/chart surface. Axis configuration: chart-level axis* props (axismin, axismax, axistitle, axisfont, ...) are Add-time only; for post-creation axis Set/Get use the chart-axis element.

chartXmlBase64.description: guarded add-only carrier for one self-contained c:chartSpace XML document encoded as base64. The host rejects DTDs, processing instructions, excessive nesting, external relationships/resources, unsupported namespaces, invalid UTF-8, schema-invalid content, and payloads above 16 MiB. Cannot be combined with semantic chart/data properties.

chartXmlProfile.description: raw chart compatibility profile. strict preserves schema-valid XML without producer-specific rewrites; hwpxChartOrderRepairV1 repairs only the reviewed CT_CatAx/CT_ValAx/CT_View3D child-order fingerprint without changing values, then runs the same zero-error schema validation.

anchor.description: if true, create a floating wp:anchor chart frame; otherwise create wp:inline.

wrap.description: WordprocessingDrawing wrap mode. Any non-inline/non-none value also implies a floating anchor.

hrelative.description: horizontal reference frame for a floating chart.

vrelative.description: vertical reference frame for a floating chart.

halign.description: optional wp:align token used instead of hposition.

valign.description: optional wp:align token used instead of vposition.

wrapDist.description: floating-frame wrap distances as top,bottom,left,right raw EMU integers.

effectExtent.description: effect extents as left,top,right,bottom raw EMU integers.

behindtext.description: place a floating chart behind document text.

name.description: drawing object name stored in wp:docPr.

description.description: drawing accessibility description stored in wp:docPr.

dispUnits.description: value-axis display units token readback (e.g. thousands, millions). Surfaces on the chart node when emitted by the value axis.
